seoTitle: Motion and Animation Checker: prefers-reduced-motion Coverage
metaDescription: Paste CSS to find animations, transitions and smooth scrolling with no prefers-reduced-motion override, plus endless or long animations.
intro: Finds CSS motion without a reduced-motion override.
why:
Motion can trigger nausea or distraction for some users, who set a reduced-motion preference.

The tool lists animations, transitions and smooth scroll, checks whether a prefers-reduced-motion rule covers each selector or all elements, flags endless or over 5 second animations, and layout-moving keyframes. It reads selectors as written and cannot see specificity or scripts.
howTo: Paste the CSS or a page with style tags.
Read which rules have no override.
Test with the OS reduce motion setting.

faq.a: 2.2.2 for moving content over 5 seconds, 2.3.3 for motion from interaction (AAA), 2.3.1 for flashing.
Short fades are usually fine. Large movement is the concern.
